'''Navneet Education Limited''' ({{BSE|508989}}) is an Indian company that is in the business of educational and children book publishing, scholastic stationery and non-paper stationery products.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.indiainfoline.com/Markets/News/Navneet-Education-revamps-BOSS/4912419820 |title=Navneet Education revamps BOSS |publisher=Indiainfoline.com |date=20 August 2010 |accessdate=2010-09-29}}</ref>

Navneet operates in three segments: publication, [[stationery]] and others. Its products are Navneet, Vikas, Gala,<ref>{{Cite web|last=Navneet|first=Gala Navneet|title=Gala Navneet|url=https://www.navneet.com/portfolio/gala|website=[[Gala-Navneet]]|date=15 December 2014 }}</ref> YOUVA.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Stationary store|first=Youva|title=Youva world|url=http://youvaworld.com|website=[[Online Stationary Store]]}}</ref> It produces titles in the children and general book categories, which includes children activity, board, story, health, cooking, [[Mehndi|mehendi]], and embroidery books. It has more than 5000 titles in English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati and other languages.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://allaboutbookpublishing.com/2010/06/24/navneet-publications-knowledge-is-wealth/ |title=Navneet Education: Knowledge is wealth – Book Publishing |publisher=Allaboutbookpublishing.com |date=24 June 2010 |accessdate=2010-09-29 |archive-date=26 February 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110226192317/http://allaboutbookpublishing.com/2010/06/24/navneet-publications-knowledge-is-wealth/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Corporate information==
It was founded in 1959, in [[Mumbai]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.indiamart.com/company/1621631/ |title=Navneet Education Limited – Writing Instruments & Supplies and Audio Video Products manufacturers and suppliers |publisher=Indiamart.com |accessdate=2010-09-29}}</ref> In 1993, it became a public company and listed its shares on [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]].
Presently{{When|date=June 2023}}, the chairman is Kamlesh S. Vikamsey and the managing director is Gnanesh D. Gala. The joint managing director is Mr. Raju H. Gala.
The chief financial officer is Deepak Kaku and the company secretary is Amit Buch.
It has its registered office at Dadar, [[Mumbai]], [[Maharashtra]].

In 2016, Navneet acquired [[Encyclopædia Britannica|Britannica India]]'s curriculum business for [[Indian rupee|₹]] 88 [[crore]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/education/navneet-acquires-britannica-indias-curriculum-division/article9270884.ece|title=Navneet acquires Britannica India's curriculum division|work=Business Line|date=16 October 2016|first=Purvita|last=Chatterjee}}</ref>
